policy_decisions.rationale_en: Inflation pressure broadened as energy and capacity costs rose, despite cooling spending and housing. The Board unanimously judged further tightening necessary.
policy_decisions.rationale_zh: 能源与产能成本上升使通胀压力扩散，消费与住房却在降温。委员会一致认为需要进一步收紧政策。

policy_decisions.rationale_en: The energy shock prolonged inflation pressure despite resilient growth. The increase was unanimous; subsequent decisions remain dependent on incoming evidence.
policy_decisions.rationale_zh: 增长保持韧性，能源冲击却延长了通胀压力。本次加息获一致支持；后续决定仍取决于新信息。

policy_decisions.rationale_en: Energy-price persistence raises inflation risks. Soft labour conditions and higher borrowing costs pull the other way; three members favoured an increase.
policy_decisions.rationale_zh: 能源价格持续偏高加大通胀风险；劳动力市场偏软与借贷成本上升形成反向影响。三名委员主张加息。

policy_decisions.rationale_en: Resilient demand met rising inflation risks. All six members backed the rate increase; two separately opposed changing the stance from neutral to calibrated tightening.
policy_decisions.rationale_zh: 需求保持韧性，通胀风险上升。六名委员均支持加息；其中两名另行反对将中性立场改为审慎收紧。
policy_decisions.instrument_zh: 流动性调节机制政策回购利率

policy_decisions.rationale_en: The BOJ raised the target by a 7–2 majority as wage and input costs spread into prices. Further normalization depends on activity, inflation and financial conditions.
policy_decisions.rationale_zh: 工资与投入成本向价格传导，日银以7票对2票上调目标。后续正常化取决于经济活动、通胀与金融条件。
policy_decisions.instrument_zh: 无担保隔夜拆借利率目标

policy_decisions.rationale_en: Export strength is lifting domestic demand while inflation and Seoul housing risks persist. Six members backed an increase; one preferred a hold.
policy_decisions.rationale_zh: 出口强劲带动内需，通胀与首尔房市风险仍在。六名委员支持加息，一名主张维持不变。

policy_decisions.provider: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
policy_decisions.rationale_en: The CBC balanced contained inflation and strong activity against global uncertainty. A discount-rate hold can coexist with rising market borrowing costs.
policy_decisions.rationale_zh: 台湾央行权衡可控通胀、强劲经济活动与全球不确定性。贴现率维持不变，并不代表市场借贷成本不会上升。
